home.title: ArGelees — Artisan jellies, made to order
home.description: Hand-moulded jellies finished with fresh fruit, made for the date of your celebration. Pick a piece, its layers and its fruit, and order on WhatsApp.

product.title: {{name}} — ArGelees
product.description: {{description}} Adjust servings, layers and fruit, then order on WhatsApp.

hero.headline: Delicacy in every layer
hero.body: Hand-moulded and finished with fresh fruit. Each piece is made for the date of your celebration: weddings, christenings, birthdays and dessert tables.

orders.statement: Orders are scheduled one week in advance

section.title: The menu
section.subtitle: Pick a piece to adjust servings, layers and fruit. The price updates instantly.

hints.layers: Pick the layers — each extra layer adds {{price}}

jardin-de-frutas.name: Fruit Garden
jardin-de-frutas.description: Clear jelly with thick-cut fresh fruit set in spokes. The fruit is decided with you before it is built.
jardin-de-frutas.imageAlt: Clear jelly crown with strawberries, purple grapes, peach and green grapes

mosaico-fresa-crema.name: Strawberry and Cream Mosaic
mosaico-fresa-crema.description: A flower mould in two layers: fresh strawberry jelly over a cream base. Unmoulded whole and delivered on its gold board.
mosaico-fresa-crema.imageAlt: Flower-mould jelly, red on top and cream below, on a gold board

uva-nocturna.name: Midnight Grape
uva-nocturna.description: Black grape over a milk layer, with a fresh cluster at the centre. The most understated piece on the menu.
uva-nocturna.imageAlt: Fluted jelly mould, dark purple over a lilac layer, with grapes at the centre

rubi-clasica.name: Classic Ruby
rubi-clasica.description: The traditional pearl mould in a single layer of red berries. High gloss and a firm cut.
rubi-clasica.imageAlt: Red jelly in a round pearl mould on a white plate

capas-de-fresa.name: Strawberry Layers
capas-de-fresa.note: Strawberry, cream and lime in layers
capas-de-fresa.description: A rectangular tray of alternating layers, with sliced strawberry across the top. Made for long tables.
capas-de-fresa.imageAlt: Rectangular jelly with red, white and green layers, sliced strawberries on top
